text:
The amphibian that can change its color to blend with its environment is the chameleon.

The German text "Geduld ist eine bittere Pflanze, aber sie trägt süße Früchte" translates to Mandarin as: 耐心是一株苦涩的植物，但它结出甜美的果实。

This proverb conveys the idea that while patience may be difficult or unpleasant in the moment (like the bitterness of a plant), it ultimately leads to positive and rewarding outcomes (the sweet fruits). It emphasizes the value of enduring hardship or waiting for the right time, as the results will be worthwhile.
